title: Epistle Context Reconstruction Worksheet
purpose: Support the primary activity for Reading Epistles as Occasional Theology.
body_markdown:
# Epistle Context Reconstruction Worksheet

Use 1 Corinthians 1:1-17; Philemon 1-25 as your evidence.

1. Write or draw three direct observations.
2. Mark one interpretation or conclusion.
3. Name one careful response.
4. Put a question mark beside anything the passage does not settle by itself.
